headline: Colombian Peso Depreciates as US Dollar Rises Above 3,415 Pesos
summary: The Colombian peso slipped past 3,415 per dollar as Wall Street equity declines weighed on emerging market currencies.
why: The Colombian peso is an emerging market currency sensitive to global investor risk sentiment and raw material prices.

impacts.name: Colombian Peso
impacts.why: Equity market selling in New York reduced demand for emerging market assets, weakening the peso.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A drop in US equities spilled into emerging market asset classes, depressing the Colombian currency.
